This plot is small but it sits close to the compound, so I can tend it well with my family. I will spread goat manure here because it is what I have, and I was able to buy two small measures of NPK 20-10-10 from the agro-dealer to boost the tired soil. I am planting yam setts I saved from last harvest — they are local but they do well on this land. My wives and children will handle the mounding, planting, and weeding; I cannot pay for hired labor when money is tight and everyone is busy with their own farms.
